newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 72.7 bln dmk in repos at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 72.7 bln dmk in repos at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 72.7 billion marks of securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed three percent rate, the rate that has prevailed since late August.
A repo pact for 75.0 billion marks expires today, Wednesday, so a net 2.3 billion marks is draining from the money market.
The central bank said banks bid for 213.9 billion marks of the 14-day funds and that it accepted 34.0 percent of the bids made.
